# ChromeLoadUnpacked (Swift)

In-process port of `LoadUnpacked` for a **GUI host** (Marcus.app).
Accessibility and Apple Events attach to that app after a user click.

**Edit `ChromeLoadUnpacked.swift` here.** Do not edit the copy under
`marcus-macos-app/marcus-swift/ComputerUse/`.

Refresh the copy:

```sh
scripts/marcus-macos-app/sync-chrome-load-unpacked.sh
scripts/marcus-macos-app/sync-chrome-load-unpacked.sh --check
```

The Go package in the parent directory remains the CLI / `browser-agent`
TTY implementation.
